# Burger Shop

## What does randomization do to this game?

All recipes, powerups, and stages are included in the item pool. What makes Burger Shop unique is
that a majority of these items are food recipes which make the game more difficult, and will be
labeled as trap items in the item pool.

- **Food items and recipes** — burgers, chicken sandwiches, sides, drinks, sundaes, shakes, snack trays, salad
  ingredients, and condiments are locked until received. Customer orders update in real-time to only include
  unlocked recipes, so customers will never ask for something you haven't found yet.
- **Level access** is gated by **Progressive Burger Shop** keys. The first 10 levels are always accessible;
  each key received unlocks the next 10. Reaching the Alien chapter (levels 71–80) additionally requires the three Alien food items.
- **Workstation**, **BurgerBot**, and **Cookies** are items in
  the pool that must be found before they can be used.
- **Powerups** (Cookie, Speed, Happy, Money) are individual items. Each powerup will be available in all levels once it is unlocked.
- **Progressive Salad** unlocks one additional salad ingredient per copy received, in a fixed order (Lettuce, Tomato, Onion, Olives, Croutons).

## What is the goal when randomized?

Beat the final Story Mode level. This requires
all 7 Progressive Burger Shop keys and the three Alien food items (Triple Bacon Cheeseburger, Ranch Dressing, Large Lemon Lime Soda).

## Which items can be in another player's world?

- **Progressive Burger Shop** (7 copies) — level access keys
- **Food items** — all burger, chicken sandwich, side, drink, sundae, shake, snack tray, and condiment recipes
- **Progressive Salad** (5 copies) — each copy unlocks one more salad ingredient
- **Gameplay upgrades** — Workstation, BurgerBot, Cookies, Cookie Powerup, Speed Powerup, Happy Powerup,
  Money Powerup
- **Filler** — Lucky Penny (and bonus recipes when the Bonus Recipes option is enabled)

## What does another world's item look like in Burger Shop?

The Archipelago client window shows a notification whenever an item is received. Customer orders update
automatically — starting or restarting a level will reflect any newly unlocked recipes. Powerup
changes take effect immediately without requiring a level restart.

tutorials.text:
# Burger Shop Multiworld Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Burger Shop](https://store.steampowered.com/app/730840/) (Steam)
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.7 or later

Currently, only Windows is supported.

## Installation

### 1. Install the Archipelago world

Place `burger_shop.apworld` in the `custom_worlds/` folder inside your Archipelago installation directory and restart
the Archipelago launcher if it is already open.

### 2. Install the game data package

Extract the provided zip file and copy the `archipelago` folder and the `properties` folder directly into your
Burger Shop installation directory (the folder containing `BurgerShop.exe`). To find this folder, right-click
**Burger Shop** in your Steam library, select **Properties**, go to the **Installed Files** tab, then click **Browse**.
The result should look like:

```
Burger Shop/
├── archipelago/
│   └── levels/
│       ├── Game.xml.orig
│       ├── Layout.xml.orig
│       ├── Order_BizChick.xml.orig
│       └── ... (remaining order files)
├── properties/
│   └── params_user.xml
└── BurgerShop.exe
```

## Joining a Multiworld Game

1. If you have not already launched Burger Shop on your computer, launch it then close it. This
will create the directory that contains your save file information.
2. Open the **Archipelago Launcher** and click **Burger Shop Client**, or run `BurgerShopClient.exe` directly.
3. Connect to your server by typing in the client console:
   ```
   /connect <host>:<port>
   ```
4. Enter your slot name and password when prompted.
5. Launch the game using `/launch` in the client console, or start it manually.
6. **Choose the `Archipelago` profile.** The client creates and manages it for you once you connect.

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Five Star Mode | On | Level checks require all 5 stars; off means any completion counts |
| Starter Recipes | Off | Adds a random large side, drink, and ice cream to your starting inventory |
| Bonus Recipes | On | Replaces filler items with bonus recipes not in the base game |
| Start with Cookies | On | Cookies added to starting inventory |
| Start with BurgerBot | Off | BurgerBot added to starting inventory |
| Customer Slots | Vanilla | Forces levels to use a specified number of customer slots |
| Character Randomization | Vanilla | Randomizes the characters in each level |

## Troubleshooting

**The client cannot find my Burger Shop installation.**
Add the following to `host.yaml` in your Archipelago directory:
```yaml
burger_shop_settings:
  game_install_path: "C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Burger Shop"
```

**The client says the Archipelago profile belongs to a previous session.**
The game is still open on the profile from an earlier seed, so the client cannot reset it. Close the
game (or use `/restart`) and it will be laid down fresh for the current one.

**Recipe changes are not showing up mid-level.**
The game reads updated order files when a level starts. Finish the current level or return to the map screen to see newly unlocked recipes take effect.
